question: Identify the display name of the user who owns the most popular (highest view count) post that is both well-finished (has a non-null ClosedDate), tagged as 'humor', and whose owner has earned at least one badge. Additionally, ensure this user has contributed to post history in the year 2011.

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN tags AS T5 ON T2."XCL_026" = T5."XCL_050"
WHERE T2."XCL_044" IS NOT NULL
  AND T5."XCL_048" = 'humor'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges AS T3 WHERE T3."XCL_002" = T1."XCL_052")
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM postHistory AS T4 WHERE T4."XCL_017" = T1."XCL_052" AND STRFTIME('%Y', T4."XCL_016") = '2011')
ORDER BY T2."XCL_030" DESC
LIMIT 1
